integration.owner: Root merges into shared knowledge; this standalone payload modifies no main source

required_inputs.read: Desired personal income/learning, local development, Faith-wide piety/XP, religious politics, building use or pilgrimage; investment horizon and competing piety uses.

Fresh actor/current Rite/Faith/main Rite; county holder, holding/building holder, barony holder, realm/top liege and each holder’s Faith. Never substitute player for the beneficiary. If valuing vassal development as the liege’s income, independently read the actual holding/tax/contract flow.
Exact instance/type/barony/county, every associated Faith and each grade, current Faith list including valid ID0, total/eminent limits and kingdom records.

Current native evaluation and cached Active separately, qualified rarity, complete inventory/slots/owners, recognition for county-holder Faith and actor Faith; selected artifact ID separately from selected slot.

Separate local fixed, county scaled, Faith fixed and Faith scaled eligibility; never apply a single Active gate to every block. Read actual recipient IDs and before/after net values with other changes controlled.
Current piety raw/scale, devotion independently, Faith free-action count, action-specific decision cooldown and creation cooldown, final quote freshness/affordability and total sequence reserve.
Exact building type and actual built/enabled state, building holder and Faith, exact AND/OR predicate, slot, innovation, gold and build time if unbuilt.
Actual host/type-specific candidate/location validity, current capital, last visits/cooldown, route/time/expense/safety and host physical availability.
Existing Faith sites before new adoption, candidate demotion’s lost benefits, artifact personal/equipment/other-site use, free action opportunity cost, and non-holy-site investments.

effect_layers.rule: Realm control enables access requirements but does not itself associate the site with actor Faith. Adoption adds a Faith/site relation; the reviewed effect does not transfer county/title ownership.

Already associated means no duplicate adoption. Historical adoption gave ordinary membership. Eminent-only Faith blocks require the Faith-specific eminent relation; another Faith being eminent is insufficient.
Adoption’s tooltip named active_site checks an associated Faith with county followers; it is not the native relic Active evaluation. Read membership, grade, recognition, rarity and Active separately.

County-holder and county blocks retain ordinary eligibility at the definition layer. Separate local fixed Active/associated-recipient-actor-Faith gate and original Title input families from Faith fixed eminent/county-holder-Faith gate; a blank inactive GUI preview does not prove all Faith fixed effects stop. Scaled terms use qualified rarity. Actual net stat changes still require independent observation.

Inspect the particular building predicate. Imam Ali uses holy-site relation AND Islam/syncretism; Samarra uses Islam/syncretism OR relation. Association neither constructs a building nor proves final enabled state. Fallback creation callback may add a missing slot, not a finished building.
Faith network relevance is only a possible destination benefit. Actual activity filters, recent visits, current capital exclusion and Hajj-Mecca restriction apply separately.

opportunity_costs.rule: Compare incremental sequence cost against the relevant alternative, not headline site count.
cost_dimensions: piety spend and independent devotion effect
per-action decision cooldown and separate creation lock
benefit lost at the demoted or abandoned relation
artifact ownership/equipment/personal benefit and alternative site use
opportunity_costs.script_note: Adopt base1000; free branch waives script piety/decision cooldown then consumes one Faith-scope free action. Common duration5years does not establish one shared all-action decision lock. Creation callback consumes a free action or sets holy_site_creation_cooldown.
opportunity_costs.historical_note: R7 demote+promote measured2000; R8 create measured2000; these are distinct input branches. R7 remove measured500 with additional preview effects not independently measured.

independent_postconditions: Read same instance and the full Faith relation/grade lists; for create prove the new instance plus preservation of prior sites.
Read wallet raw/scale independently and devotion separately; do not infer either from an ACK or cached preview.
Read current Active/rarity, every artifact owner/slot/recognition and actual benefit recipient/modifier separately.
Read the relevant action cooldown/free pool and building/activity state if those were the reason for acting.
An ACK, pending response, reset model or accepted=false after dispatch cannot authorize a retry; preserve intent and query independent world state.
shared.research_boundary: Definitions, historical native observations and actual applied net modifiers are different evidence levels. Native caller/beneficiary closure from the eminent/relic topics can refine this model; absence of a read does not grant the benefit.

declared_type_coefficients.semantics: Raw source coefficients only; not actual net gains. Separate fixed vs per-qualified-rarity scaled blocks and their native applicability. Percentages are coefficients times100; development_growth is additive.
declared_type_coefficients.conditional_reallocation_comparison: Nadjaf and wisdom have the same diplomacy_per_piety_level coefficient1: switching the one eminent slot gives coefficient delta0 for that term when the same recipient qualifies. Compare the other lost/gained blocks, not a second copy of diplomacy.
declared_type_coefficients.relic_requirement_warning: Do not turn the scaled-piety/XP relic requirement into a universal requirement for fixed Faith effects; consumers and actual net values are distinct.

native_applicability_source.faith_fixed_and_scaled: Producer requires eminent membership and county-holder Faith equality; the full producer loop has no Active18 gate. Scaled values still depend on the loaded HolySite-scope expression.
native_applicability_source.local_fixed: Active18 plus actual recipient actor Faith association, reachable through the original two native Title families; do not invent holder==actor or award it to all same-Faith characters.
native_applicability_source.county_scaled: Active18 plus county-holder Faith equality, no eminent requirement; runtime aggregate receiver identity remains unclosed.
native_applicability_source.gui_preview: GetActiveEffectsDesc suppresses all text while inactive; this is not proof that Faith fixed contribution stops.

evaluate_in_order: Exclude already-associated sites before any resource comparison.
Name the objective, beneficiary and exact missing condition that adding the Faith relation would satisfy.
Keep original AI candidate generation, GUI item validity, decision script gates and fresh native final Can/quote as distinct stages; no stage proves optimality.
Compare existing-site management/promotion before expansion, and budget any demotion, promotion and relic provision as separate legal actions.
If building/pilgrimage is the payoff, query its own predicate and current state before crediting value.
Compare an existing associated site and an adoptable existing instance with a new chosen type/location.
Resolve actual county-holder recipient; ordinary wisdom can retain local definition eligibility while eminent-only XP remains excluded.
Require exact type/barony/artifact tuple, fresh normal Can with bypass0, and separate price freshness/affordability evidence.
Budget artifact opportunity cost, capacity/kingdom records and creation lock; do not infer absence of a lock or free action count from a prior payment.
Do not credit a Samarra mosque unlock merely because a site is created when the building holder already meets the Islam OR branch.
